dialog.lobby.trees:
The palm trees behind me were made
by %s.

Don't they look great?
dialog.lobby.volume:
Use headphones for a better experience.

Turn the volume of all categories up.

A good indicator is making sure you can hear clearly your own footsteps.
dialog.sunny_jr.1:
Hey, you must be the new archeologist right?

There is no reason to wonder around these parts other than studying the %s.
dialog.sunny_jr.2: After the last cave in some of us were trapped inside and the rest… Well, I lost an arm myself, others weren't so lucky.
dialog.sunny_jr.3:
Right, just last night my team found a new way in.
Our local guide says it may lead to the innermost chamber. 
We might finally find the legendary %s.
dialog.sunny_jr.4: Alright, alright… Stop staring at me like that. I was just stalling for night to come. Its cool near the oasis, but out there you wouldn't even be able to reach the tomb during the day.
dialog.sunny_jr.5:
Just follow this corridor to the left. Our guide is waiting on site.
You should also pick up that flashlight, some tunnels aren't propperly lit.
With it even the stars will feel brighter.

Good luck!
dialog.sunny_jr.6:
Just follow this corridor to the left. Our guide is waiting on site.

Good luck!
dialog.pachecont.1:
Here kid, help me out here. We're gonna be rich.
Nothing good will come from exploring those old ruins.

Terrible things will happen to you, as they did to my friends.
dialog.pachecont.2: The %s is not worth the danger.
dialog.pachecont.name: Miner
dialog.ctarron.1:
Holo, you must be the new archeologist.

Im %s, the leader around here.
This pyramid is my families inheritance. Im just here to make sure you only study and don't steal anything.
dialog.ctarron.2:
Or thats what id like to say but this next room seems to be the innermost chamber.

Our ancestors warned us about disturbing the heart, and my survival from the recent %s is proof enough of its validity.
dialog.ctarron.3:
The keys are long gone, you'll have to lockpick your way in.
Its %s you understand how to do it in case anything goes wrong.
dialog.ctarron.player.1: How do I open that door?
dialog.ctarron.tutorial:
Click %s on the door to start lockpicking, to stop lockpicking press %s.

To unlock the door, you must find the correct directional combination.
Hold down the required %s%s%s%s keys (⬆ ⬅ ⬇ ➡) and, while holding them, press %s to try lockpicking.

The order doesn't matter, it will open only if you are holding all the correct directions and none of the wrong ones when you press %s.

You can try to brute-force it, but it's worth searching your surroundings. My ancestors were quite forgetful and carved the combinations into nearby vases, mixed in with other drawings.

Give it a try!

Thanks for playing ^^

If you had fun, please make my day by letting me know.
